arguments.name: Animation Timeline
arguments.description: Step 1 of the animatic chain (D80): compile the episode's beat ledger into timeline.json (beats as frame ranges, world per beat, crossing windows, state flips) and report pacing against the measured hold band; the one file every composition reads.

arguments.name: episode_root
arguments.description: Episode directory holding the beat ledger (beats-v2.json or beats.json), contracts (timeline.json, blocking/, keys/, light.json, worlds/), rubric.md and studies/ (e.g. media/showcase/v3).

arguments.name: renderer
arguments.description: The rendering project root (Remotion here): where `npm run animatic`, `npm run xsheet` and scripts/animation/ live.

arguments.name: context
arguments.description: Owner notes, rulings or the previous step's result.

arguments.name: output_root
arguments.description: Caller-owned production artifact directory for studies and receipts.
